card.name: Long-term follow-up and cancer risk wording
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of phrases about long-term follow-up or lasting health risk, such as 'years' after 'additional' or 'over the', and 'in' after 'increase'. Also partway through tumor names like basal cell carcinoma or meningioma.

modes.label: Time spans
modes.description: The word 'years' in phrases about follow-up or time passing.
modes.example: observed for up to 10 additional<< years>>, with little additional exposure to piog

modes.label: Cancer and risk terms
modes.description: Inside tumor names or risk phrases about cancers.
modes.example: the incidence of basal<< cell>> carcinoma was 0.4% in

modes.label: Risk of harm phrases
modes.description: Linking words in statements about increased health risk.
modes.example: caused “no discernible increase<< in>> health risks” outside Japan

card.writes: It promotes covid and pandemic terms in Chinese and English and suppresses words for long periods like decades and centuries.
card.plain: It fires on wording about long-term follow-up and cancer risk, and nudges the model toward covid-related words.
